name: iterative-check-execution
hypothesis: Output-mismatch failures result from checks that are never actually executed in the program. The prompt says 'commit a check early' but doesn't make clear that the check must be RUN iteratively with await bash() during development to validate progress. Models create checks but don't call them, so they don't discover failures before setting done: true.
prediction: Forcing explicit iterative check execution surfaces failures earlier (bugfix-statemachine, refactor-behavior-preserving, wiring-stats output-mismatch cases). Expected: 33-35/42 passing (+1 to +3 from fixed output-mismatch failures).
